aboutGame.title: What is RoFront?
paragraphs: RoFront is a Roblox real-time territory conquest game based on Open Front. According to its official description, players start from a single nation, attack neighbors, build cities, ports and factories, forge alliances, and launch nukes while competing against 88 advertised player nations and hundreds of tribes. The stated win condition is conquering 80% of the world.

This fan wiki provides general strategy suggestions and clearly stated documentation limits. It does not claim verified active codes, exclusive official media, comprehensive control tables, confirmed custom maps, a confirmed server capacity, a subreddit, a Discord invite, a roadmap, or patch notes. Use in-game information for current mechanics, costs, and release details.

modules.description: A starting module for new players. It covers general first-match flow, how to read the in-game map and menus, and cautious early expansion habits. It does not provide verified formulas or shortcut methods.

highlights.detail: Open the game and review the live match state, map, and available menus.
Identify your nation, nearby territory, and any in-game objectives shown.
Expand gradually when it is safe; avoid overextending before you understand neighbors.
Keep the described 80% world conquest goal in mind while adapting to alliances and threats.

items.question: What is RoFront?
items.answer: RoFront is a Roblox real-time territory conquest game based on Open Front, according to its official description. Players start from a single nation, expand, build, ally, and compete to conquer 80% of the world.

items.question: What should beginners focus on?
items.answer: General beginner advice is to learn the in-game interface, expand carefully, watch neighbors, and avoid overextending before you understand the live map.

items.question: Does RoFront have verified active codes?
items.answer: This fan wiki does not list verified active codes. Check the official Roblox game page or developer channels for any code announcements.

items.question: How many nations are in RoFront?
items.answer: The official description advertises 88 player nations and hundreds of tribes. This is not a verified server capacity.

items.question: What is the win condition?
items.answer: The official description states that conquering 80% of the world is the win condition.
